messages:
maya (Marketing): Heads up — planned release announcement goes live Thursday 10:00 UTC. Need final changelog link, docs permalink, and eng sign-off on rollout windows. Who can own the deployment playbook?

aj (Eng): I can own rollout. Need final model-flavor mapping and fallback policy. Can marketing hold embargo until 10:00?

sofia (Product): Confirming canary for 30m, then full at 11:00 UTC. Targeting eu-west then us-west. Canary traffic at 10%.

noah (Docs): Draft of docs is up: https://redwood-internal/docs/rls-3.2 — finalizing API examples now. Will open PR by EOD.

maya (Marketing): @noah perfect — can you paste the exact permalink we should use in the blog and tweets? Also @aj, do we have a one-line changelog summary for the headline?

aj (Eng): Changelog short: "Improved batching & prefix cache for ~2x throughput on short contexts; new quantization profiles and stability fixes". Full changelog: https://internal.changelogs/1975-rs3.2

izzy (Solutions): Need a one-paragraph customer-friendly blurb for the webinar page. Draft: "Lower latency, predictable throughput — join our webinar to see real benchmarks and migration tips." Thoughts?

lina (Growth): Webinar scheduled noon same day (12:00 UTC). Need speaker list + two demo scripts. Also want a benchmark slide with qps/latency. @aj can you confirm numbers we can show?

aj (Eng): Quick numbers for slides: p50=45ms, p95=120ms, throughput=2k tokens/s per GPU (single-request); with batching ~7k tokens/s. Will supply CSV and chart PNG by EOD.

maya (Marketing): Great. @deploy-bot can you confirm release window reservation?

deploy-bot: [deploy-scheduler] Release window reserved Thu 10:00-12:00 UTC. Canary: 10:00-10:30 UTC (10% traffic). Full rollout target: 11:00 UTC.

sofia (Product): One ask — keep rollback target under 5 minutes. @aj ok?

aj (Eng): Yep. We'll monitor error-rate and KV cache hit ratio. I'll post a short runbook in this thread with thresholds.

noah (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/481 — includes examples and changelog excerpt. Please review and leave comments.

maya (Marketing): Marketing assets checklist: blog post + changelog excerpt, docs link, webinar signup page, customer email, social card. @lina can you gate the email send until docs PR merges and deploy-bot reports canary success?

lina (Growth): Will queue email for 10:15 UTC send contingent on docs PR merged and canary OK. Also will set tagging for inbound leads.

izzy (Solutions): For inbound leads routing: route webinar signups to Growth queue, and enterprise trial requests to Solutions. Add label "priority:enterprise" for >100 seat requests.

lina (Growth): Done — I'll configure tags in the CRM and add automation.

aj (Eng): Posting canary checklist: 
```
- Verify model variants loaded
- KV cache warmup 15m
- 10% traffic to canary
- Monitor p95 < 250ms
- Rollback if error-rate > 1%
```

maya (Marketing): Thanks. Last ask — send me final permalinks for blog + docs by EOD so I can schedule social + email threads.

noah (Docs): Done — docs permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/3.2 (also linked in PR).

maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll update the launch schedule and ping again tomorrow morning :pray:"
